sources.note: Nothing. It is a code request plus a raw 210-item wordlist; no prose on phonology. The transcription's raised tick (ka'nu 'eye', mu'ku 'nose', po'lu 'tooth', u'pu 'salt') lines up with Telugu/Tamil geminates, so it is evidently a length/gemination device, not a stress mark; no statement either way.
